description: This file contains step definitions for behave testing framework, specifically for handling undefined steps and generating step snippets.

methods.name: text_indent
methods.description: Utility function to indent multi-line text by a specified number of spaces.

methods.name: step_undefined_step_snippets_section_exists
methods.description: Checks if the behave command output contains the section for undefined step snippets.

methods.name: step_undefined_step_snippet_should_exist_for
methods.description: Verifies that an undefined step snippet exists for a given step in the behave output.

methods.name: step_undefined_step_snippet_should_not_exist_for
methods.description: Verifies that an undefined step snippet does not exist for a given step in the behave output.

methods.name: step_undefined_step_snippets_should_exist_for_table
methods.description: Checks multiple steps from a table to ensure their snippets exist.

methods.name: step_undefined_step_snippets_should_not_exist_for_table
methods.description: Checks multiple steps from a table to ensure their snippets do not exist.
